title: My first little aport for the resource s

posts.author: Domagames
posts.body: I have been receiving help from this great community for a long time. I haven't mastered the art of making plugins with scripts, but I consider that I have a good hand at editing images. I have made several edits to create unique sprites and tilesets, which I would like to share with you. Here I leave one, a variation of the maid from "people". In my project, this maid is called "Silfi", I hope she will be of help to anyone.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Hi there! Wanted to make sure you intended to open this thread as a workshop and not as a standalone resource thread.
@Domagames
If you intend to take requests, can you take a quick look at the section requirements?
Rules - Rules - Please Read
All general forum rules apply in addition to the following:  Opening a Workshop:   1- Tag your post. The first tag should be the type of service you're offering: Graphics, Music, Writing, Scripting or Other. The second tag should narrow your field of expertise: Tileset, Character, Background...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
If not, we can get this moved over to the correct resource section ASAP.
Additionally, can you let everyone know what the terms are for this resource? What resource does this edit originate from? Thank you!

posts.author: Domagames
posts.body:
Ms Littlefish said:
¡Hola ahí! Quería asegurarse de que tenía la intención de abrir este hilo como un taller y no como un hilo de recursos independiente.
@Domagames
Si tiene la intención de aceptar solicitudes, ¿puede ver rápidamente los requisitos de la sección?
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/rules-please-read.8407/
Si no, podemos mover esto a la sección de recursos correcta ASAP.
Además, ¿puede hacer que todos sepan cuáles son los términos de este recurso? ¿De qué recurso se origina esta edición? ¡Gracias!
Click to expand...
It is an independent resource, I do not accept requests or commissions, I edited it from an RPG maker mv base sprite, that of "People". With Photoshop I made the edits such as shadows and cuts, color change, etc. I have several resources that I have made this way for my games, but I wanted to share this one so that you can use it freely.
